Hi @eng-39, regarding tiered_fee: the design review agreement was that the minimum fee only applies to accounts that processed something in the month; a volume of 0 is charged 0, not min_fee_cents.

Hi @eng-18! Sure thing. Regarding journal_imbalance (LEDGERLIB-111), the design review decision was that every line must have exactly one side filled in. A line with both a debit and a credit (or with neither) should raise a ValueError; lines are never netted against themselves.

Hi @eng-78! Regarding parse_transaction: it was agreed in the design review that the memo is everything after the third separator. Only the first three ';' split fields are used; any further ';' characters should be treated as part of the memo text (e.g., "Lunch; team offsite") and should not cause the line to be rejected.

@eng-38 from my design-review notes on convert_currency: conversions between two non-base currencies use the cross rate in a single step — cents * rate[target] / rate[source], rounded once at the end. Never convert to base, round, then convert back; the double rounding can drift by a cent.
